name: Jahmyr Gibbs
body: The Lions are off in week 6 of 2026, so Jahmyr Gibbs does not play and scores nothing this week. There is no designation for him on the Tuesday-night list, and he sits first on the Detroit depth chart, with Sione Vaki second and Jacob Saylors third behind him. He has carried this backfield all season long, and the week off changes nothing about that role. Keep him rostered all week, fill his spot with a running back whose own club plays this week, and he is back next week at home against Green Bay.
